name: Maduros
steps: Choose plantains with mostly black, soft skins. Slit the peel lengthwise and remove it; cut the fruit into thick diagonal slices.
Warm oil in a wide skillet over medium heat. Lay slices in one layer with space between them.
Cook 3–4 minutes per side until dark caramel-gold on the outside and soft inside, lowering heat if sugars brown too quickly.
Drain briefly, add a small pinch of salt and serve warm with lime wedges.
tips: Green plantains will not become sweet maduros; wait until the peel is heavily spotted black.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
